name: Daily ZCTA-Level Mortality Counts
description: Daily ZCTA-level dataset reporting Medicare beneficiary hospitalizations and mortality. For each ZCTA and calendar day, the dataset includes the number of hospitalizations and deaths among Medicare beneficiaries.

content.year: Int32: Calendar year of the data
content.date: Date32[day]: Specific date of death count
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in the specified zcta on a given date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations in the specified zcta on a given date
